slots.label: Heading 1
slots.default: Design first, then install, then verify

slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: A proper survey establishes what the building does to the signal, where the users and devices actually are, and what they are doing. The design that follows specifies access point positions, mounting, channel and power plan, and the cabling each position needs. Installing first and adjusting afterwards is how sites end up with equipment in the wrong places and no way to know why it is not working.

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: After installation the network is verified rather than assumed, walking the site to confirm real-world throughput and roaming behaviour. Wireless depends entirely on what is underneath it, so

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: are the two services most often specified alongside it.
